about_the_game:
LIMINAL CAT is an adventure game inspired by 'liminal space' and 'cats'.Become a cat and dash through the beautiful yet eerie world of liminal space.

　【Synopsis】

A cat woke up in a cold, inorganic tiled room, with nothing to rely on around it, and began to wander in search of an exit in the endless empty liminal space.

　Liminal Space

This work involves wandering through various liminal spaces such as back rooms and pool rooms.The uniquely nostalgic, eerie, and beautiful world of liminal spaces guides players through a range of emotions. It seamlessly depicts an endless surreal world.

　Cat

In this game, by making the player character a cat and utilizing a third-person perspective, you can experience a liminal space like never before. The unique actions and animations of cats provide a soothing presence in the empty liminal space, and the combination of 'liminal space' and 'cats' evokes new emotions.

【 About Video Distribution】　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　

No advance notice is required.

We would appreciate it if you could put a link to the store page of this game in the summary section of the video.

We are not responsible for any damage caused by the posting or distribution of videos. Thank you for your understanding.

【Handling of games】

Please refrain from unauthorized reproduction of this game, secondary distribution, or any unauthorized diversion of internal assets by analyzing the game.
